task_description: Show the network details of an interface name such as eth0.
Open a firewall port given as a number.
Return the logged-in sessions of a given user name.
Calculate the checksum of a file with a system tool.
Clone a git repository from a URL.
Run one of the maintenance jobs: backup, cleanup or reindex.
Commit staged changes with a message given by the user.
Speak a message with a text-to-speech tool.
Format a byte count as a human-readable size.
Check out a release by its version number such as 2.4.1.
